retention.heading: User retention
retention.subheading: Of users who signed up in week W, what share were active on day N — classic Dn retention. Computed for both ticks (climbs logged) and any in-app activity.
retention.definitions: Cohort = signup week (UTC). Dn counts a user if they had activity in the 24-hour window starting N days after signup (so D7 = active exactly on day 7, not anytime in the first 7 days). Ticks = at least one climb logged in Boardsesh (Aurora-imported ticks excluded). Any activity = a tick, party-session host or join, favorite, playlist (created or pinned), follow (user, setter, or playlist), new-climb subscription, comment, vote, proposal vote, or feedback submission. Cohorts younger than the window show —.

gymOwnerReassign.title: Move gym ownership
gymOwnerReassign.intro: Hand a gym to another account when it changes hands — a sold gym, a departed committee member, a claim approved to the wrong person. The listing's sync freeze is left exactly as it is, and the outgoing owner stays on as a gym admin.

locationSync.title: Location sync freezes
locationSync.intro: Release a human edit only when the upstream listing should take over again. This does not run a sync; the next matching source refresh may replace details or bring a deleted listing back.
locationSync.empty: No frozen listings match this search.

confirm.title: Release this sync freeze?
confirm.body: The next matching location sync can update {{name}} again. Review the warnings and record why the freeze is being released.
confirm.deletedWarning: This listing is deleted. A matching source can bring it back on the next sync.
confirm.ownerProtectedWarning: This gym has a user owner or an approved claim. The ownership guard remains active after the freeze is released.
confirm.noSourceWarning: No sync source is currently linked to this gym. Releasing the freeze will have no effect until a source matches it.
confirm.moonBoardWarning: MoonBoard location syncs run by hand, not on a schedule. After the freeze is released, upstream changes land when someone runs the next MoonBoard location sync.
confirm.reasonPlaceholder: Why should upstream data take over again?
confirm.reasonStored: This reason will be stored in the audit log.

snackbar.failed: Couldn't release the sync freeze. The list has been refreshed.
